### Ultimate Chess Version 1.1.2

All pieces now have the correct moveset! fixed an error on the server when selecting a game piece and when dyeing a game piece.

 

### Additions

- Fixed an error on the server when selecting a game piece and when dyeing a game piece.

- Corrected Queen and King moveset to respect Chess,
